script: My boss banned coaching. I started returning incomplete forms—then something happened.. Only stamp the forms that are complete. I worked the front desk, watching people bring in forms all day. Every single one had that tiny slip—missing date, signature in the wrong box, a checkbox skipped. Classic. I'd call it out, stamp it, and they'd fix it. No one had to come back later. Then my supervisor, the guy who hated coaching, drops the line: "Your job is not to coach people. Only stamp the forms that are complete." I didn't even think about it. I just checked, handed back the incomplete ones, and kept my hands clean. Fast forward to lunch, the waiting area is a hot spot of frustrated folks, all asking why their forms were getting rejected. The same supervisor strolls out, smirks, and says, "Can you please just tell them what's missing?" And there you have it—old system, new chairs. (Literally insane, right?)
